data.headline: Flood Warning issued October 28 at 6:40PM MDT until October 29 at 6:45PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
data.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

data.areaDesc: Lyon; Osceola; Sioux; O'Brien; Plymouth; Cherokee; Woodbury; Rock; Dixon; Dakota; McCook; Minnehaha; Hutchinson; Turner; Lincoln; Bon Homme; Yankton; Clay; Union
data.description:
Areas of fog have developed early this morning, with dense fog
confined to areas mainly near river valleys. Though fog may spread
a bit farther, the greatest chance of dense fog will continue to
be along and near river valleys through the morning commute
Thursday. Make sure to use your low beam headlights when driving
in fog and consider leaving extra time to get your destination.
Any fog should lift entirely by 10 am or shortly afterwards.
